title: Twins for Change
summary: Offline-first AI tutor for bilingual Yorùbá–English classrooms that grounds Gemma 3 answers in a 15,791-row corpus with hybrid retrieval-augmented generation.

award.text: First place in the ProFuturo challenges

problem: Language models such as Gemma 3 4B often make things up when they answer in Yorùbá. Twins for Change grounds every answer in real data: it retrieves verified bilingual examples from a 15,791-row corpus and gives them to Gemma before it answers.
points: Hybrid search: dense bge-m3 and keyword BM25 vectors in Qdrant, merged with Reciprocal Rank Fusion; the top three documents are passed to gemma3:4b before it answers.
Bilingual answers: the explanation is in Yorùbá, and key terms and the summary are in English.
Verified sources: every answer shows the three corpus documents it was based on.
Compare mode: plain Gemma and Gemma with RAG answer the same question side by side.
Offline: after a one-time setup, everything runs on a single laptop.
architecture: FastAPI backend and REST API with the RAG pipeline (storage, retrieval, prompts), an Angular frontend, models served by Ollama, and a Qdrant vector database; docker-compose deploys Qdrant, Ollama, FastAPI and Caddy.

dataset.description: dataset_rag.csv, built in notebooks/creation_dataset_rag.ipynb from public benchmarks.
